description: Electric Vehicle Charging Station Usage (July 2011 - Dec 2020) is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The City of Palo Alto Open Data Portal, first launched in 2012, includes over 100 datasets. This dataset is about Electric Vehicle Charging Station Usage from July 2011 - Dec 2020 and is from the City Infrastructure section, source is City of Palo Alto Public Works Department, Planning Department, Utilities. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Transportation, Electricity. Its keywords are electric vehicles, electric vehicle charging, electric vehicle supply equipment (EVSE), charging stations. The portal shows 2025-12-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is No license, or terms of use, asserted by data producer for this dataset was found.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
